title: Kopitiam Keycap Clicker
description: Press a red-dot pau or a green-striped kopi cup. Both caps fit the same jade saucer keychain, inspired by a Singapore kopitiam breakfast.
printNote: Open the colour 3MF as a project in Bambu Studio. Under Objects → Red-dot pau, Pau dough uses filament 1 (cream) and Red dot uses filament 2 (red). Match the colours to your AMS Lite spools. Print the saucer and either cap, then fit one full-height MX-style clicky switch and a split ring. Test the fit before use.
dimensions: 40.4 × 36 mm base · approx. 34 mm tall with pau
